flow_ref: User story only (no OCMS flow deck); siblings OCMS49.1, 49.2, 49.4, 49.5
code_summary: ocmseserviceapi workflows/receipt/{ReceiptController,ReceiptServiceImplement}, utilities/pdf/PdfGeneratorService, workflows/furnish/FurnishValidationService (comparison only). ocmseserviceui route/route.ts, pages/Payment, pages/Furnish. The other repos (ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi) have no clearance slip code.
note: No Clearance Slip code in any of the six repos: a case-insensitive grep for clearance is empty in all repos, the eservice UI routes are only payment and furnish-particulars (route.ts:17-38), and there is no check for permanently suspended warrants of arrest per ID. What can be reused is the PDF engine PdfGeneratorService.generatePdfFromHtml (PdfGeneratorService.java:44) and the receipt ZIP/PDF download pattern (ReceiptController.java:38), but that is a payment receipt with a receiptNo from the transaction, not a clearance slip and not a new unique serial number. Evidence 0 percent means the story is not built in the code on main, even though the spreadsheet status is 'Built - Has gap'; check whether the code lives on another branch or repo that was not included. Cannot verify from repo: the value of X months, Singpass login, and the gateway. No flow deck, test case, or UAT was checked.
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no code for this story on main; confirm with the team whether the code is on another branch before using the 'Built' status as evidence

steps.step: Offender yang sudah login lolos pengecekan: semua warrant of arrest permanently suspended dalam X bulan terakhir
steps.detail: No Clearance Slip eligibility code in the eservice API or any other repo. A grep for clearance/warrant/WOA across the six repos finds no check for permanently suspended warrants per ID within X months. FurnishValidationService:74 only excludes PS notices for furnish, which has a different purpose. This belongs to story 49.2; it is recorded here as a missing prerequisite.

steps.step: Sistem membuat clearance slip dalam format PDF
steps.detail: No clearance slip template or service. Only the generic PdfGeneratorService.generatePdfFromHtml:44 (HTML to PDF) exists, with one user, the payment receipt via the receipt.html template (ReceiptServiceImplement.java:91). The PDF engine can be reused, but the clearance slip content is not written.

steps.step: Clearance slip mendapat nomor seri unik
steps.detail: No serial number generator for the clearance slip. The only number in the PDF is receiptNo read from the payment transaction (ReceiptServiceImplement.java:102), not a number created for the slip and not available to an offender without a payment. No clearance table or sequence in the repo.

steps.step: Clearance slip ditampilkan kepada offender di portal
steps.detail: The eservice UI routes are only payment (route.ts:17-33) and furnish-particulars (route.ts:38). No page or component shows a clearance slip with its serial number.

No clearance slip download endpoint. v1/printslip (ReceiptController.java:38) returns a ZIP of payment receipts by receiptNo or notice list, unrelated to warrants. A new endpoint with an eligibility check before generating the file is needed.
No button or page to print a clearance slip in the UI. Browser print cannot be verified because the display page does not exist.
